model_selection_basis: one already-restored model, before any task outputs; not capability-proven
entry_conditions: Explicit user approval for model calls and context-service configuration
Exact deployed chat-template/tokenizer and effective num_ctx verified before generation; no silent input trim
Registry/source/model/config/permit hashes bound and fail-closed client contracts passed
Local endpoint loading/API preflight budget included; no cloud fallback
Development reservation exposure consequences and future independent evaluation feasibility reviewed
Per-request durable log and global output/wall/request caps enforced by registered future driver
Request-level hard watchdog and global wall/storage enforcement must be verified; client late-response rejection is not proof of physical cancellation

proposed_quality_screen.failure_action: No-Go for current model/budget support or no identified communication space; no automatic sample/model/prompt rescue

radio_scope: Reliable identity profile, no added losses or artificial task deadlines. Record actual UTF8/framing; no deployment net-benefit claim.
